detail: Each ⚠ box (Map to Xbox, Map to vJoy, Map to Logical Device, Send OSC) is at least as wide as its '⚠ <name>' text while the warning shows. test_editor_widths forces the ⚠ in all four; the Xbox cases failed on the old QML and pass now. User chose to keep the ⚠ in the box (2026-10-11).
title: CI: Map to Xbox editor cuts off '⚠ Xbox 360 Controller' in its drop-down
